name: Fallen Moonstone
summary: At Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale, night elves gather luminous, magically charged Fallen Moonstones from its tranquil waters. Sacred lunar energy gives the stones restorative power that can renew vitality and cure severe frailty.

sections.title: Gifts of the Night Sky
sections.body: Southeast of Astranaar, Fallen Sky Lake once yielded many stones along its shores and shallows. Night elves prized their restorative magic and lunar blessing when ordinary remedies failed. Gathering them grew dangerous after corrupt Shadethicket bog beasts overran the lake. Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, hoarded every stone it found on a small island at the lake’s center, cutting the local Kaldorei off from a vital source of healing.

sections.title: A Father's Salvation
sections.body: In Astranaar, young Relara Whitemoon fell gravely ill. Ordinary treatments broke her fever, but left her faded and near death, with only a few breaths remaining. Her father, Pelturas Whitemoon, knew only a moonstone’s concentrated restorative power could renew her depleted vitality. A stone recovered from the Shadethicket Oracle’s hoard gave the child the strength she needed to live.

faq.answer: A Fallen Moonstone is a luminous, magically charged stone from Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale. Sacred lunar energy gives it restorative power, which night elves use to replenish strength in the severely weakened.

Fallen Moonstones come from Fallen Sky Lake, southeast of Astranaar in Ashenvale. Once scattered across the lake bed, they were gathered and hoarded on a central island by the hostile Shadethicket bog beasts.

faq.q: Who possesses the moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake?
faq.answer: The Shadethicket Oracle hoarded the Fallen Moonstones on an island in the center of Fallen Sky Lake. The Oracle leads the corrupted bog beasts there.

faq.q: Why does Pelturas Whitemoon need a Fallen Moonstone?
faq.answer: Pelturas Whitemoon needs a Fallen Moonstone to save his young daughter, Relara. Though she survived a debilitating fever, she remained critically frail, and he knew a moonstone’s magic could restore her vigor.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, relics linked to Elune’s radiance are sacred instruments of preservation. They offer divine healing when mortal medicine fails.
Devotees of the Sisterhood of Elune see the lunar glow of these stones as a sign of healing grace.
